meta.fullName: Department of Environment and Natural Resources

concepts.name: Evolutionary Refresh
concepts.idea: Preserve the official DENR seal equity while delivering a production-ready SVG with authoritative motion for digital dashboards.
rationale: Keeps all official seal recognition — forest green border, gold accents, three stars for Luzon/Visayas/Mindanao, tree canopy metaphor
Converts live text to paths for reliable rendering across all platforms
Two-colour system (forest + gold) works in 1-colour, reversed, embroidery, and screen
Slow 10s breathing animation conveys institutional stability and permanence
